ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the center of the circle is C, and A, C, E are on the same vertical line segment, with A at the lower end of the circle and E at the upper end of the circle. AB is the horizontal tangent passing through A, and B is to the left of A. The oblique line segment BCD passes through the center C of the circle and intersects the circle at D on the upper right side of the circle. There are two gray shaded regions in the figure: the left shaded region is the part of triangle ABC that lies outside the circle; the right shaded region is the sector region enclosed by radii CE, CD and arc ED. Angle θ is marked at C, corresponding to the central angle in triangle ABC, and also equal to the central angle of the right sector ECD. Reasoning: Let the radius of the circle be r, then AC = CE = CD = r. Because AB is the tangent to the circle at point A, AB ⟂ AC, and triangle ABC is a right triangle. Also because ∠ACB = θ, in right triangle ABC, tan θ = AB / AC = AB / r, therefore AB = r tan θ. Thus the area of triangle ABC is (1/2)·AC·AB = (1/2)r^2 tan θ. The part inside triangle ABC occupied by the circle is the sector with C as the center and central angle θ, whose area is (1/2)r^2θ, because θ is measured in radians. Therefore the left shaded area is the area of triangle ABC minus the area of this sector, namely (1/2)r^2(tan θ - θ). The right shaded region is sector ECD. Since CE and CA are opposite rays on the same straight line, and CD and CB are opposite rays on the same straight line, ∠ECD = ∠ACB = θ. Therefore the area of the right shaded region is (1/2)r^2θ. The two shaded areas are equal if and only if (1/2)r^2(tan θ - θ) = (1/2)r^2θ. Since r > 0, simplifying gives tan θ - θ = θ, that is, tan θ = 2θ. Conversely, if tan θ = 2θ, then substituting into the above area formulas, the two shaded areas are equal. Therefore this is a necessary and sufficient condition.

Given $0<\theta<\frac{\pi}{2}$, what is the necessary and sufficient condition for the two shaded areas to be equal?

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as follows: C is the circle center, A and E lie on the vertical diameter ACE, AB is the horizontal tangent at A, and the slanted line BCD passes through C and meets the circle at D on the upper right and at an unlabeled point on the lower left. The right shaded region is the sector ECD, while the left shaded region is the part of right triangle ABC outside the circle. Let the circle radius be r. Since AB is tangent at A, AC is perpendicular to AB, so triangle ABC is right with AC = r and angle ACB = θ. Hence AB = r tan θ and area(ABC) = (1/2)r^2 tan θ. The portion of the circle inside triangle ABC is a sector of angle θ, so its area is (1/2)r^2 θ. Therefore the left shaded area is (1/2)r^2(tan θ - θ). The right shaded sector ECD also has central angle θ, so its area is (1/2)r^2 θ. Equating the two shaded areas gives (1/2)r^2(tan θ - θ) = (1/2)r^2 θ, hence tan θ = 2θ. Conversely, if tan θ = 2θ, the same area formulas show the shaded areas are equal, so this is necessary and sufficient.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中圆心为 C，A、C、E 在同一条竖直线段上，A 在圆的下端，E 在圆的上端。AB 是经过 A 的水平切线，B 在 A 的左侧。斜线段 BCD 经过圆心 C，并在圆右上侧与圆相交于 D。图中有两个灰色阴影：左侧阴影是三角形 ABC 中位于圆外的部分；右侧阴影是由半径 CE、CD 和圆弧 ED 围成的扇形区域。角 θ 标在 C 处，对应三角形 ABC 中的中心角，也等于右侧扇形 ECD 的中心角。

推理：设圆的半径为 r，则 AC = CE = CD = r。因为 AB 是圆在 A 点的切线，所以 AB ⟂ AC，三角形 ABC 是直角三角形。又因为 ∠ACB = θ，所以在直角三角形 ABC 中，tan θ = AB / AC = AB / r，因此 AB = r tan θ。于是三角形 ABC 的面积为 (1/2)·AC·AB = (1/2)r^2 tan θ。

三角形 ABC 内部被圆占据的部分是以 C 为圆心、中心角为 θ 的扇形，其面积为 (1/2)r^2θ，因为 θ 用弧度度量。因此左侧阴影面积为三角形 ABC 面积减去该扇形面积，即 (1/2)r^2(tan θ - θ)。

右侧阴影是扇形 ECD。由于 CE 与 CA 是同一直线上的相反射线，CD 与 CB 是同一直线上的相反射线，所以 ∠ECD = ∠ACB = θ。故右侧阴影面积为 (1/2)r^2θ。

两块阴影面积相等当且仅当 (1/2)r^2(tan θ - θ) = (1/2)r^2θ。由于 r > 0，化简得到 tan θ - θ = θ，即 tan θ = 2θ。反过来，如果 tan θ = 2θ，则代入上述面积公式，两块阴影面积相等。因此这是必要且充分条件。
